construction: grouped minimum packet after autonomous repository triage

requests.reason: Identity and actual deployment have the highest leverage on roster-role and target reassessment.

requests.evidence_needed: Grouped item-detail/team screenshots showing equipped abilities/AP and acquisition state (owned/free/BND/EVO/rerollable) for decision-relevant roster cards.
requests.preferred_evidence_form: batched screenshots; no per-player narrative required
requests.reason: These fields can unlock realized-fit, zero-coin and free/BND coverage decisions after identity/deployment is established.

requests.evidence_needed: Observed usage notes/screens only where actual usage differs from lineup/deployment.
requests.reason: Observed usage is descriptive and lower priority than identity, deployment and ownership state.
